name: glyhub_GPST000079_N
title: Postnatal mouse skeletal-muscle N-glycome
description: Released N-glycans from skeletal muscle at postnatal days 1, 7, 14 and 21, with three source observations at each age.
details: Supplementary Table S5 individual abundance columns are used; derived fold changes, SEMs and group averages are not treated as additional samples. The source isomer identifiers and partial linkage annotations are retained. This matrix supports the study of the digalactose-to-sialic-acid switch during muscle development.
annotation: Source-derived compositions and original annotation fields are preserved; unknown linkages are not inferred.
